t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Each gnome relates to a different colour basket within the game. There are yellow baskets and red baskets. Each basket has a different mushroom yield and during the game the amount a basket yields may diminish so change colours to try and gain a higher yield if you can. THis is particularly important on the X5 multipliers as you can earn more points. AT certain points within the game the red and yellow baskets may switch over.

vb_textbox.text: You must respond within 1.5 seconds so be quick. x5 multipliers are the most important. The gnomes and baskets relate to different colours. Purple and Brown seemed to be the best for me. Blue yellow and Green not very good. Good luck
